evidence_plan.requirement: methods used to reduce data sparsity effects

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address data sparsity in neural machine translation systems, including Byte-Pair Encoding and data augmentation techniques.

claims.text: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) is used for effective word segmentation to alleviate the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
Data augmentation methods, such as mix-source and back-translation, are employed to increase training data and improve translation quality.
